verdicts.reason: A: the left-to-right banner flow works, and the headline and subcopy are centred together at a readable size. But the product can is shrunk to a tiny, illegible sliver, there is dead space between the can and the text block, and the logo wordmark is minute. B has the same tiny can and logo problems, and is worse: the subcopy is shrunk to near-illegible fine print and pushed left so it no longer lines up with the headline above it, which breaks the alignment and the text grouping.
